3/S0.subgoal: Explain the application potential of XR and the main domains of AR applications, emphasizing augmentation of real-world content rather than immersion.

3/S1.subgoal: Describe concrete AR application examples in consumer/customer experience and healthcare, including navigation, product visualization, virtual try-on, and medical use cases.

3/S2.subgoal: Explain the technological categories of AR systems, distinguishing marker-based applications from markerless subtypes such as location-based, superimposition, projection-based, and outlining-based.

3/S3.subgoal: Summarize the lecture by contrasting VR and AR applications and their system categories.
